added_failures_note: unmeasured: the reviewed manifest names no base gate log, so the added-failure count was not taken

findings.text: follow-on: index_state_stamp re-lists aggregate, version, aggregate_identity and runs_identity that index_stamp at reckon/ledger.py:1127 already owns, so a member later added to index_stamp will not reach the memo and the memo will silently ignore that state change, which is the failure class this node exists to close; deriving the record from index_stamp and omitting the index member by name would keep one owner of the member set.

follow-on: the monkeypatch of ledger.index_stamp is inert after the change because _attempt_inputs now calls ledger.index_state_stamp at reckon/mcp_views.py:1532; measured zero calls to index_stamp during _attempt_inputs at 33ce96405, so the test's ledger-index invalidation coverage is gone while the test still passes on its live-pointer assertions.

follow-on: the recorded head gate names the base revision 2dc7f5677 in its header while it validated the modified tree, so a reader cannot tie the passing head arm to the landed commit 33ce96405 without re-running it, which I did and which passed.
